name: SR02
summary: SR02 is HARIBIT’s special-purpose biped humanoid robot. It combines articulated arms and hands, a sensor-equipped head and legs intended for work across unstructured terrain. The manufacturer positions it for inspection, search and rescue, and other hazardous tasks. Its official brochure identifies onboard depth cameras, lidar and inertial sensing, together with internally developed joints and motion control. Commercial ordering is promoted through the manufacturer, while stock and delivery timing remain unverified.
